rules.rule: Each uncle and aunt has a specific term that says which side and which relative: on your father's side his older brothers are 伯伯/伯父, his younger brothers 叔叔, his sisters 姑姑 (older or younger alike); on your mother's side her brothers are all 舅舅 and her sisters 姨/姨妈.

rules.rule: Several relatives of the same kind are numbered by birth order (排行): 大 for the eldest (大伯, 大姑, 大舅, 大姨), then 二, 三, 四… (二叔, 三姨), and 小 for the youngest (小姑, 小姨). Some regions use other words for 'youngest', which relationship.js treats as equal to 小 (e.g. 幺, 细, 满, 尾).
rules.why: Xinhua 排行: '兄弟姐妹依长幼排列的次序'. CC-CEDICT: 大伯 'father's older brother (esp. his oldest brother)', 大姑 'father's oldest sister', 小姑 'father's youngest sister', 大姨 'mother's eldest sister', 小姨 'mother's youngest sister', 老幺 '(coll.) youngest child'. relationship.js numbers relatives 大 = 1, 二, 三 … and 小 = last, and rewrites the prefixes 尕, 幺, 细, 满, 碎, 晚, 末, 尾, 幼 to 小.
rules.regional_note: relationship.js does not say which 'youngest' prefix belongs to which region.

rules.rule: In-law words depend on whose family it is: a wife's in-laws are 公公/婆婆 (together 公婆; his family is her 婆家); a husband's in-laws are 岳父/岳母, colloquially 丈人 (老丈人) and 丈母娘 (her parents' home is the 岳家; for her it is her 娘家). Face to face, after 改口, both say 爸/妈.
rules.why: CC-CEDICT: 公婆 'husband's parents; parents-in-law', 婆家 'husband's family (traditionally where the wife moves into)', 岳父 'wife's father', 岳母 'wife's mother', 丈人 'wife's father', 老丈人 '(coll.) father-in-law (wife's father)', 丈母娘 'wife's mother', 岳家 'wife's parents' home', 娘家 'wife's family (before marriage)'; Xinhua 娘家: '已婚女子称自己父母的家'. CC-CEDICT 改口: a bride 'starts to call her husband's parents 爸爸 and 妈妈'; 改口费 goes to both the new daughter-in-law and the new son-in-law.
